text.description_html:
Hamilton MS-301-BN, 10" Brushed Nickel Decorative Letter Slots

This gorgeous letter box is 10 inches long by 3 inches high. It is made out of solid brass and has a brushed nickel finish. The lavish embellishments around the give the Hamilton mail slot timelessness. As easily as it would look just right on the door to a classically styled building this letter mail slot would compliment more modern architecture. What is best about this mail slot is its ability to make an interesting statement without having to adhere to a specific time period or setting; and it is made with high quality backed up by a lifetime warranty.

The Satin Nickel Finish is hand brushed for a superior high quality finished product. Give your home or office a center piece an elegant touch that you can be extremely proud of.

Also Available: Bronze Patina Decorative Letter Box

Features of Hamilton MS-301-BN Brushed Nickel Decorative Mail Slot

  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Length: 10"
  • Height: 3"
  • Packaged with both Exterior and Interior mail doors.
  • Packaged complete with mounting hardware.
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty.
  • Hamilton MS-301-BN Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
